classification: Validated bounded experimental selection; not an absolute hardware bound or Daily Trend main score
baseline: Previously selected seven SQL rewrites, rerun on the same AWS host with the same frozen engine
external_prerequisites: Access to the dataset S3 source recorded in selected-cases.json
The pinned engine and tools JARs identified in engine-manifest.json; prepare.sh supports their retained S3 source
Host driver, P2P, UCX, NVMe and NUMA prerequisites in host-prerequisites.json and the preparation scripts

raw_archive.name: ceiling-261126-complete.tar.gz
raw_archive.scope: Raw logs and event data are locally retained for deeper investigation; compact measurements are included here

verification.selected_runner: All SQL fingerprints and override contracts verified without starting a separate extra suite
verification.actual_execution: Measured final full suite uses the same launch_group and run_cases execution path
verification.services: Owned Spark process groups and GPU compute processes were empty at the final lifecycle audit

retention: AWS instance retained until explicit user release

alternative_selection.scope: Reproduces the fastest observed complete screening configuration; it has not passed the final per-query ABBA selection gate

selection_before_q11.scope: Retains the earlier complete combination; the Q11 rewrite passed its isolated gate but the subsequent full-suite score was slower

suggested_next_comparison_baseline.reason: Use the earlier combination as the comparison baseline until the full-suite long tails and possible cross-query effects are isolated; this does not reject the measured Q11 single-query benefit
